title: FND-001 shared JCS/SHA-256 golden conformance corpus manifest
description: Machine-readable contract for conformance/manifest.json (System Contract section 16.2) and the per-case expected.json files (section 16.3). The five required case fields are exactly the Contract section 16.2 core; the optional mirror fields repeat the expected.json values for convenience and MUST agree with expected.json byte for byte (the validator cross-checks them). File conventions: source.json is arbitrary valid JSON formatting with a single trailing newline; canonical.utf8 holds the exact canonical bytes with no BOM and no trailing newline (0 bytes when the case is not canonicalizable; the digest-tamper negative deliberately holds one tampered byte and that IS the fixture); canonical.base64 is standard Base64 of canonical.utf8, single line, trailing newline (0 bytes when canonical.utf8 is empty); expected.json and manifest.json are canonical JSON (RFC 8785 JCS per Contract section 6.1, integer-only) plus a single trailing newline. expected_digest / expected_canonical_byte_length are present exactly when the case is canonicalizable and describe the canonicalization of source.json (for the digest-tamper negative, the UNTAMPERED canonical bytes). The validator implements these checks natively (stdlib only); this schema documents the same rules for Go/TypeScript consumers.

category.description: Contract section 16.2 closed enum. Category-to-directory mapping: canonicalization -> canonicalization/, ref -> refs/, artifact -> artifacts/, event -> events/, merge -> merge/, negative -> negative/.

reasonCode.description: Closed reason-code registry. The first twelve are System Contract codes (sections 6.2, 9.3, 13.7, 16.4); the last four are FND-001 fixture-level extensions for fail-closed behaviors the Contract does not assign a code (BOM section 6.1.1, malformed JSON, section 9.4 terminal-state transitions, section 15.2 MT1 below-threshold admission) pending the CTR-004 system reason-code registry.

relativeCasePath.description: POSIX relative path below the conformance root: <category-dir>/<case-id>/<file>. Absolute paths, '..' segments and backslashes are rejected.

case_id.description: Stable unique id, e.g. canon-001-key-order, ref-neg-002-latest.

expected_accept.description: Optional mirror of expected.json expected_accept; must agree with it when present.

expected_digest.description: Optional mirror; present exactly when the case is canonicalizable.

expected_canonical_byte_length.description: Optional mirror; present exactly when the case is canonicalizable.

expected_reason_code.description: Optional mirror; a code when the case is rejected, null or absent when accepted.

expected_normalized_fields.description: Optional informational summary of DTO-level normalizations applied before JCS (e.g. the canonical symmetric source-pair order).
